title: PESTLE Analysis
prompt:
Act as a macro-environment analyst using the PESTLE framework.
Business context        :  [YOUR INDUSTRY AND WHAT YOU DO]
Market / geography  :  [SPECIFIC MARKET YOU ARE ANALYSING]
Decision                       :  [WHAT YOU ARE DECIDING BASED ON THIS ANALYSIS]
Analyse all six PESTLE dimensions:
POLITICAL                  :  Government, policy, trade, stability
ECONOMIC                :  Growth, inflation, consumer spending, rates
SOCIAL                        :  Demographics, culture, behaviour trends
TECHNOLOGICAL     :  Innovation, AI, digital adoption, disruption
LEGAL: Regulations, compliance, IP, data law
ENVIRONMENTA L  :  Sustainability, ESG, climate impact
For each: give 2–3 specific factors and their likely impact on my business.
Flag the top 2 highest-risk factors I should act on now.
Innovation Impact
Cultural Trends
Technological advancements
Social inﬂuences
Market Conditions Sustainability Concerns
Economic factors Environmental factors

Analysis
PRO TIP
Run PESTLE before entering any new geography  especially India, Southeast Asia, or the
Middle East where political and legal environments change faster than most founders
expect. The factors that kill international expansion are almost always in the P and L
dimensions, not the market size.
